title: Contextual Research Attention Item
description: Contextual phase outputs preserve historical schema versions. New researcher items require decision_priority and response_kind under consequential_researcher_decisions_v1. The supplied frozen user-inquiry reference governs overlap and new inquiry ceilings. Optional recommended_option_id binds a justified suggestion to an exact existing authored choice option, first in new arrays; it is absent for study facts and never selects or saves an answer. Catalog checks enforce membership without rewriting historical records.
